threads.body: [General] This reference now resolves to a metric definition that omits `messaging.consumer.group.name`, but the stable RocketMQ 5.0 simple-consumer test verifies that `messaging.client.operation.duration` emits that attribute (`RocketMqSimpleConsumerTest.java:203-222`). The previous `f4822aab` definition included it, so this generated update would make the instrumentation list under-document emitted telemetry. Please regenerate after ensuring the preview SimpleConsumer metric metadata is included/merged, retaining a RocketMQ-specific definition with the consumer-group attribute.
